goal: Test whether strictly-past number rankings can be conformalized into naturally small 6-of-49 prediction pools that retain reproducible 5-of-6 coverage without target tuning.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: v294 searches recurrent set states; v317 calibrates a coverage threshold from strictly prior rank residuals.
v316 uses transport geometry; v317 uses finite-sample conformal rank coverage and a hard playable-set-size gate.

regime.reason: Keep one shared 6-of-49 regime; no cross-regime mapping inside v317.

method.targetEvent: At least 5 of the 6 winning main numbers are contained in a pre-draw conformal pool.
method.nonconformityScore: For each historical draw, rank all 49 numbers using a base ranking computed only from earlier draws; the score is the rank position of the fifth-best-ranked winning number. Smaller is better.
method.calibration: For each target draw, use only previous nonconformity scores from the frozen rolling calibration window. The conformal quantile is ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))/n with the standard finite-sample upper order statistic convention.
method.playability: The conformal pool is the top K ranked numbers where K=max(6, conformal quantile). The draw is playable for this experiment only when K<=8. No truncation from K>8 to 8 is allowed.
method.budget: For K=6..8 evaluate all C(K,6) lines. At K=8 this is 28 lines and 14 EUR under the project Bonoloto-equivalent 0.50 EUR line convention; real stake remains zero.

stage1_2SelectionRules.failurePolicy: If no configuration meets all predeclared gates in development, close v317 without opening blind OOS.

matchedNull.type: Exact hypergeometric matched to each emitted pool size K
